title: A report-shape pause can be answered or retried
lead: Seen 2026-10-20 (run ork-20261020-120934-e8ac): the run paused with 'report shape: no Tests: N passed, M failed line; no ## Owner needed section'. ork answer failed with 'run needs a pending question and a non-empty answer' because the pause has no question (questions: []). The only commands left were stop and a new run. A pause needs a way to resume: a corrective answer or a retry of the round. Related to S26 (how the engine marks a stop as a question with options). Ask the owner before building.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Per the owner decision (not yet recorded, ask first with key engine.pause-resume): a report-shape pause accepts ork answer RUN TEXT, which resumes the role with the text.
- A pause for any other reason without a question says what the owner can do.
- ork status shows the pause reason and the next command.
